# auto-api-go

> Go client for auto-api.com — car listings API from 8 automotive marketplaces (encar, mobile.de, autoscout24, che168, dongchedi, guazi, dubicars, dubizzle).

## Install

go get github.com/autoapicom/auto-api-go

## Quick Start

client := autoapi.NewClient("your-api-key")
offers, err := client.GetOffers(ctx, "encar", &autoapi.OffersParams{Page: 1, Brand: "BMW"})

## API Methods

- GetFilters(ctx, source) — available filters (brands, models, body types)
- GetOffers(ctx, source, params) — search listings with pagination and filters
- GetOffer(ctx, source, innerID) — single listing by ID
- GetChangeID(ctx, source, date) — get change_id by date (yyyy-mm-dd)
- GetChanges(ctx, source, changeID) — changes feed (added/changed/removed)
- GetOfferByURL(ctx, url) — listing data by marketplace URL

## Auth

- GET requests: api_key query parameter
- POST /api/v1/offer/info: x-api-key header
